title: Committees, commissions & reports (Dec 2025-Feb 2026)
quote: 16th FC: vertical devolution retained at 41% - states had demanded 50%

boxes.title: 16th Finance Commission (2026-31)
items: Chair ==**Arvind Panagariya**==; award **1 Apr 2026 - 31 Mar 2031**; Art. **280**
Tabled **1 Feb 2026** with Budget **2026-27**; vertical share ==**41%**==
⚠ **Tax and fiscal effort** removed; revenue deficit grants discontinued
Grants **₹9.47 lakh crore**; local bodies **₹8 lakh crore** (rural 4.4, urban 3.6); **80%** basic + **20%** performance
Disaster sharing **90:10** NE/Himalayan, **75:25** others
Centre FD **3.5% of GDP by 2030-31**; states **3% of GSDP**

cards.title: PM CARES
lines: CAG audits NDRF, not PM CARES

boxes.title: UGC Equity Regulations 2026
items: Replace **2012** rules; cover ==**SCs, STs and OBCs**== (OBCs excluded in draft)
**Equal Opportunity Centre** mandatory; **Equity Committee** chaired by Head
Dropped: fine for "**false complaints**"
UGC: **1952** set up; statutory - **UGC Act, 1956**; **Radhakrishnan** Commission **1948**

items.what: **16th** Census: ==first fully digital==; caste counted first since **1931**

boxes.title: Other bodies & schemes
items: **NCW**: statutory (Act **1990**); **NCST**: constitutional, **Art. 338A**, **89th** Amendment
ECI conference of SECs **24 Feb 2026** - first since **1999**
**PM-RAHAT**: cashless up to ==**₹1.5 lakh**== for **7 days**; MV Act **Sec 164B**
**Rah-Veer**: Good Samaritan **₹25,000**; **Sec 134A**
Airports: **11 AAI** airports in **5 bundles** - first bundling

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: 16th FC vertical share = ==**41%**== (not 50%); new criterion = **contribution to GDP**
Ad hoc HC judges: **Art. 224A**; cap **10%**
Public Trust Doctrine: **M.C. Mehta vs Kamal Nath (1997)**
PFRDA: **M.S. Sahoo** = assured payouts; **Narayan Ramachandran** = investment rules
Friendship groups: **64** countries, **11** members (Speaker **Om Birla**)
